svg.title: Сгибание ног с резинкой — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Prone bilateral resistance-band leg curl, side view. Athlete lies face down on floor with chest, abdomen, pelvis and thighs resting, hands under head. A single thin elastic band clearly connects BOTH ankles to a stationary low anchor well beyond feet, on foot side away from head, in both phases. Left: legs straight behind and ankles near floor. Right: heels curl toward buttocks by BENDING KNEES, thighs and pelvis stay on floor and ankle attachment rises, band stretches diagonally downward back to exactly the same low anchor. Keep band visible as a distinct paired thin line, anchored to a short fixed post bolted to floor. No bench or machine. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
